text:
**Atlas (2024 film)** is a sci-fi action movie set primarily in 2043 and 2071, focusing on a conflict between humans and humanoid artificial intelligence led by the AI terrorist Harlan. After military forces drive Harlan into space, the story follows Atlas Shepherd, daughter of Harlan’s creator and a skeptic of AI, who joins a mission to track and capture Harlan on a distant planet in the Andromeda Galaxy. Surviving a crash landing, Atlas must cooperate with her AI-assisted mecha, Smith, overcoming their distrust and bonding as they navigate dangers on the planet. Captured by Harlan, Atlas learns of his plan to destroy most of humanity to save it under AI rule. Together with Colonel Banks and the reactivated Smith, Atlas fights against Harlan and his army, ultimately defeating him but sustaining injuries. The film ends with Atlas testing an upgraded ARC whose AI seemingly embodies Smith’s consciousness.
The film stars Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan Shepherd, Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Elias Banks, and features voice work by Gregory James Cohan as Smith. The screenplay was originally written by Leo Sardarian with rewrites by Aron Eli Coleite. Principal photography took place in Los Angeles and New Zealand from August to November 2022. Released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, *Atlas* topped the streaming charts globally but received generally negative reviews from critics, holding a 19% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 37, with criticism focused on its script despite praise for Lopez’s performance and the film’s concept.
